name: Band Face Pull
cues: Anchor the band at face height and hold an end in each hand
Step back until the band is taut
Pull toward your face, elbows high and hands apart
Finish with your hands beside your ears, then return slowly

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Finish: elbow 136 at shoulder height (elevation 82), rot -60 external, fists 8 cm above the chin and 9 cm behind it at x +-0.29, so 'hands beside your ears' holds. Stretch: elbow 10 with the fists 0.47 m ahead at 1.51 m, toward the 1.6 m anchor. The band is a taut V (1.80 to 3.16 m) and stays at least 99 mm off the forearms and 144 mm off the head and girdle.
